home_paragraph: Creativity and ingenuity on display! Design Day promises to amaze you with our students' innovation and inspiration! Through the <ceedLink>Centre for Entrepreneurship and Engineering Design (CEED)</ceedLink>, students have worked closely with external partners of the Faculty of Engineering to develop solutions for real clients. This event showcases engineering design projects, and celebrates the achievements of our students. For more information on Design Day, <designDayLink>click here</designDayLink>.
